lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Oh, hello! I am Barnaby. I have a <color=red>problem</color>.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: I lost my <color=red>books</color>! I had three.

lines.speaker: Old Barnaby
lines.text: Look around the camp. The books spin round and round.

afterLines.speaker: Old Barnaby
afterLines.text: Thank you for my <color=red>books</color>. I love to read them!
